movingAdsTierReview.runtimeCheck: Actual applyAttachments with the candidate weapon, Basic barrel and regular 5 Rnd magazine returns moving ADS floor 0.32, ADS 433 ms and sprint recovery 233 ms.
movingAdsTierReview.rosterCheck: All 62 candidates with a named MovingZoomedMinAnglesArrayIndex registry record use index 3. Two candidates lack named coverage; no value is inferred for them.
movingAdsTierReview.decision: Retain 0.3 as the raw base value. The existing shared tier-3 calculation produces the Sym effective value 0.32 without an Interdictor exception.
movingAdsTierReview.limitation: The named registry index is verified. This comparison does not decode the engine's tier-array formula or establish modifier activation order.

damageCurveCorroboration.title: Thereâ€™s More to the Interdictor Than You Think (The Stats Are LYING)
damageCurveCorroboration.evidenceMethod: Video page identity and exported English auto-generated captions; no independent frame-by-frame hit test.
damageCurveCorroboration.correctionSummary: The author corrects his earlier narrower upper-chest range to 106-164 m. Later narrower references are not used as a separate measured result.
damageCurveCorroboration.decision: Use the named tweakable health curve as the evidence-backed Interdictor integration candidate. Its whole-metre chest kill boundaries agree with the author's report. This does not prove global precedence for other weapons or modes.
damageCurveCorroboration.displayDecision: User confirmed graph remains capped at 100 damage, after applying body-part multipliers. Calculations retain the full 150-damage plateau.

distributionModelReview.scatterExpression: const bAng = rngB() * Math.PI * 2, bR = spread * rngB();
distributionModelReview.referenceExpression: const bAng = rngRef() * Math.PI * 2, bR = spread * rngRef();
distributionModelReview.behavior: Both paths sample radius uniformly and angle uniformly. They do not read spreadDyn.distExp.
distributionModelReview.status: Unresolved game formula. No exponent-based sampler has been implemented.

externalResearch.scope: Describes BFV uniform-radius ADS spread; does not establish the BF6 exponent formula.

runtimeIntegration.limitations: Shared modifier calculations retain their existing estimate warnings and model limits, including bipod deployment and recoil recovery. Integration is not a claim that all attachment state/operation mechanics are resolved.
